title: If, Then, or Else
label: ch:ur-if-then-or-else
canDo: I can say what will happen if something happens (agar bārish huī, to …; agar voh āe gī, to …), give a warning with varnā, and set a condition (ek shart par).

payoff.summary: Complete UR-R274-if-and-otherwise: say what will happen if something happens, or else.
